description.value:
Somebody yelling over a stolen tower about what the Licensed did last week, with names and dates. Open Band Signals are the reason three settlements have a curfew, and the reason two of them don't have one any more.

Allies in range gain a +1 status bonus to saves against fear and emotion effects. It is very hard to panic while somebody is still talking.

7th — Talk Back: allies may spend Encore to reroll a failed save, not just a check, and get +1 circumstance on the reroll.
15th — Everybody Listening: Broadcast range becomes 120 feet, and allies who step out of it keep the benefits for 1 round.

cinderfall.incomplete: Same reasoning as `numbers-track` (SB4/SB3/P5). The 7th-level "Talk Back" (Encore-spend to reroll a save, SB1+SB2) and 15th-level "Everybody Listening" (range change + a benefit that persists after leaving range, SB3 plus a novel "sticky" duration shape not found in the 34-key inventory) compound the base blocker.
